summary: A toggle for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when other visible text names the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while checked.

checked.note: Current state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; draws the track and positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation. Covers the track.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Circle that slides to the end when checked; decorative.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). Not fired when checked is set from code.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary; thumb moves to the end (mirrored in rtl).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl: setFormValue(value) only while checked; validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing, error -> customError); formResetCallback restores the checked attribute default; formStateRestore restores checked; a disabled fieldset ancestor disables it and it is not submitted; <label for> on the host activates it.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20px (default) or 24x16px (sm); the label is part of the clickable row. sm relies on the gap to the label for the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009)

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox input exposes the on/off state through checked
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect right away
The setting needs a consequence explained
The setting must be on before the form submits
useCases.use: required with a label that states it

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that is only recorded when the form is submitted
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as immediate; a recorded choice is a checkbox
A switch is a single on/off value
The label is the only name for the switch
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that states the setting

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern, label row beside the track.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> or a custom element with role="switch"?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox with role="switch": Space, focus, validity and form semantics come free, same base as Checkbox (FormAssociated + NativeControl).

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No, like Checkbox: the attribute is the default that form reset restores.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: default (32x20) and sm (24x16), from the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens; the thumb takes size.icon.default and size.icon.sm.

openQuestions.question: How does the off track meet 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)?
openQuestions.answer: Border in color.input (3:1, as Checkbox) and a solid 3px focus ring; to be listed as drift from the visual reference once built.

openQuestions.question: Does the contract need new semantic tokens?
openQuestions.answer: No. size.switch.* already exist; everything else aliases existing semantic tokens.
